segments.text: Tangle. 3D billboard ads that pass the street-view test.
Brands pay for the city's best corner to run a 3D ad. But if the screen is a few degrees off, launch night looks broken.
Give Tangle a brief, product photos and the real screen. Gemini 4 Argon builds the 3D scene.
An independent checker measures what people on the street actually see.
Here the real corner is {true_angle} degrees, not 90. The error is {c2_max_v1} degrees, over the {c2_max_limit} limit. Fail.
Argon watches the street-view video, reads the report and proposes a fix. Argon proposes; the checker decides.
The error drops to {c2_max_best} degrees. Still over the limit, so no certificate.
Any screen: corners, curved walls, roadside. You get panel files, street-view proof, and a certificate only when every check passes.
Any product, just a prompt. Tangle makes 3D screens provable. Built today at the Gemini 4 Argon hackathon.
